summary: Full e2e testing of Степпе Тэйбл (Mongolian food delivery) completed successfully. All 7 backend pytest tests pass and all 11 frontend flows verified via Playwright including menu load, category filter, search, cart CRUD, localStorage persistence, empty-cart state, form validation, checkout POST /api/orders, success page and new-order reset.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu is seeded once on startup; if MENU_ITEMS in server.py is edited later, DB will not be updated (idempotency issue). Consider upserting by id on each startup.

OrderCreate accepts client-supplied item.name/price fields but server correctly recomputes price from menu — good. However name is trusted from client and stored as-is; consider overriding with server-side menu name to prevent tampering in stored orders.
order_number uses random 6-digit int — small collision risk (~1e6 range). Consider uuid-based or sequence with uniqueness check.
MongoClient close in shutdown handler is not awaited (motor's close returns coroutine in newer versions); harmless for now but worth reviewing.
test_credentials: N/A — app has no authentication (test_credentials.md is empty as expected)
seed_data_creation: Backend created 1 test order MH-248049 via UI flow and additional orders via pytest (prefixed with TEST_ notes/account_name). No cleanup performed as orders are additive-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 menu items seeded and returned by GET /api/menu. Categories: pizza, meat, chicken, set, noodle, drink. Full happy-path checkout works. Cart persists via localStorage key 'mfd_cart'. Server correctly recomputes total from menu prices (client price is ignored). Empty items -> 400; invalid item id -> 400; missing required fields -> 422 (pydantic). Cyrillic address requires min 3 chars.
